schema.$comment: inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24): HCIGAMES-HEXAD-SCALE-EN, scale table and 'How to use the scale'. The distribution is dated 2019-11-10 and cites both the 2016 paper and the 2018 validation; the 2016 paper's own item table is paywalled, so identity with it is not verified
schema.title: Hexad scale response
schema.description: One respondent's ratings of the 24 Hexad items on a 7-point Likert scale; a type's score is the sum (or mean) of its four items.

P1.description: Philanthropist: It makes me happy if I am able to help others.

P2.description: Philanthropist: I like helping others to orient themselves in new situations.

P3.description: Philanthropist: I like sharing my knowledge.

P4.description: Philanthropist: The wellbeing of others is important to me.

S1.description: Socialiser: Interacting with others is important to me.

S2.description: Socialiser: I like being part of a team.

S3.description: Socialiser: It is important to me to feel like I am part of a community.

F1.description: Free Spirit: It is important to me to follow my own path.

F2.description: Free Spirit: I often let my curiosity guide me.

F3.description: Free Spirit: Being independent is important to me.

F4.description: Free Spirit: Opportunities for self-expression are important to me.

A2.description: Achiever: I like mastering difficult tasks.

A3.description: Achiever: It is important to me to continuously improve my skills.

A4.description: Achiever: I enjoy emerging victorious out of difficult circumstances.

D2.description: Disruptor: I like to question the status quo.

D3.description: Disruptor: I see myself as a rebel.

R1.description: Player: I like competitions where a prize can be won.

R2.description: Player: Rewards are a great way to motivate me.

R3.description: Player: Return of investment is important to me.

R4.description: Player: If the reward is sufficient I will put in the effort.
